Federal ICP — Renewal of residence permits (includes student and sponsor/host grace-period categories)
sources.note: Official ICP renewal service page. It lists a 180-day grace period for students after completing their studies and a 60-day grace period for residence permits issued with a guarantor or host. These are separate categories; verify the applicant's exact permit, sponsor, emirate and circumstances. Page last updated 12 November 2026 when checked. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: Department of Home Affairs — Student visa application rule changes (subclasses 500 & 590)
sources.note: Official change notice. Review the 2 October 2026 commencement date, onshore application eligibility, subsequent Student visa applications and family-member inclusion rules. Detection is not legal interpretation; verify affected applicant category and exceptions against the current legislation before counselling.

sources.name: Federal Register — Migration Amendment (Student Visa Reform) Regulations 2026 (F2026L01347)
sources.note: Primary legislative instrument registered 1 October 2026; commenced 2 October 2026. Review exact scope, application dates, exceptions and transitional provisions.

sources.name: UAE Government — Residence visa for studying
European Commission — Student visas in Europe
German Embassy Colombo — Students (national visa)
German Embassy Colombo — Long-stay national visa requirements
Department of Home Affairs — Student visa condition 8105 (work limitation)
sources.note: Primary official condition page. Verify the visa grant notice and VEVO for the individual applicant; current published guidance describes the 48-hours-per-fortnight limit, exceptions and course-session rules. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — Work off campus as an international student (24-hour weekly limit)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; counsellors must manually review current 24-hour limit, DLI/full-time eligibility, programme start, scheduled breaks and permit conditions.

sources.name: IRCC — Proof of financial support (living-cost table)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; manually verify the current application-date threshold, family size, Quebec rules, tuition/travel exclusion and source-of-funds evidence.

sources.name: Make it in Germany — Visa for studying (2026 funds and student work)
sources.note: Federal Government guidance: check current blocked-account amount and student work limits; distinguish study visa from visa to seek a place and verify individual residence conditions.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Working on a student visa
sources.note: Official student work eligibility and conditions; 25-hour limit applies only where the student's visa and course conditions permit it. Verify eVisa/visa letter.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Changes to student visas (27 October 2026)
sources.note: Official INZ announcement of changes effective 27 October 2026: master's-by-research work-rights change for new applications, English-language ability as a key factor, broader processing suspension grounds, and extension of relevant post-course expiry period from 1 month to 2 months. Check application-date scope and current visa conditions; detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — PAL/TAL requirements, exemptions and validity (2026)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check; manual review required for 2026 PAL/TAL cap-year validity, public DLI degree-granting master's/doctoral exemption from 1 January 2026, Quebec CAQ, school/level changes and other exceptions. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — Post-graduation work permit eligibility
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify PGWP-eligible DLI and exact programme, programme length, full-time history, 180-day application window, language thresholds, field-of-study/CIP requirement by study-permit application date, 2026 eligible-field list freeze, public-private partnership exclusions, distance learning, transfers and leave exceptions. Obtain the exact 6-digit CIP code in writing from the DLI and cross-check against IRCC. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: IRCC — PGWP field of study and eligible CIP codes
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. IRCC states the eligible-field list is frozen for 2026; manually verify exact 6-digit CIP 2021 code, applicant's study permit/PGWP application dates and any grandfathering against the live official list. Do not infer eligibility from a programme title.

sources.name: IRCC — Designated learning institutions list and PGWP-eligible programme details
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify exact institution, DLI number, province/campus, PGWP-eligible DLI list and exact programme details. IRCC explicitly states not all programmes at a listed DLI qualify. Cross-check all general PGWP, language and field-of-study requirements. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: UK Home Office — Register of licensed sponsors: Students
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify legal sponsor name, Student sponsor category, rating and current licence status close to application; confirm exact course/CAS and sponsor remains licensed. The register was updated 11 November 2026 when checked.

sources.name: GOV.UK — Student visa: course requirements and CAS
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify exact course level, mode, study location, approved qualification, ATAS if applicable, CAS details and 6-month application window. Do not treat an offer as a CAS.

sources.name: Australian Government — CRICOS registration
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify provider and exact course CRICOS registration, campus/location, course code and registration dates; provider registration alone does not establish every course/campus is registered.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Rules for approved education providers and Code signatories
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify provider's current Code of Practice signatory status through NZQA and exact programme/campus; international students cannot study at a non-signatory institution. Provider status is not visa approval.

sources.name: Dubai Government — Student Residence Visa
sources.note: Official Dubai Government overview. Manually verify the exact institution, host/guarantor, campus, study programme and current GDRFA route. Institution host/guarantor status is not automatic for every course or provider.

sources.name: Visit Dubai — Apply for a student visa
sources.note: Dubai's official destination portal explains the institution-managed GDRFA process and typical applicant documents. Treat as guidance; confirm exact requirements and fees through the institution and GDRFA for the applicant's case.

sources.name: Federal ICP — Issuing residency permit (student conditions and documents)
sources.note: Official ICP service page. It lists student-specific documents, programme-based residence duration and a 180-day stay after completion of the study period. Do not conflate with GDRFA Dubai's 60-day statement after expiry/cancellation; confirm emirate, permit category and circumstances.

sources.name: MoHRE — Cabinet Resolution / Executive Regulations (student training and employment permit category)
sources.note: Official MoHRE-hosted executive regulations identify a student training and employment permit category for students already in the UAE, subject to conditions and employer approval. Verify current permit process, employer jurisdiction and eligibility before any work begins.

sources.name: GDRFA Dubai — Issuing a visit visa for study, training or rehabilitation
sources.note: Separate single-entry 30/60/180-day study or training visit-visa route. Verify host letter, passport validity, purpose, duration, extension and live fees. Do not confuse with student residence permit.

sources.name: GDRFA Dubai — Golden Residence for top students and graduates
sources.note: Exceptional 10-year merit-based residence category. Manually verify grade/GPA, graduation date, university ranking, certificate authentication and ICP/local nomination approval; not a standard student visa benefit.

sources.name: German Embassy Colombo — Opening / unblocking a blocked account
sources.note: Official Colombo mission guidance on blocked-account opening/unblocking. For student applications, confirm the current minimum amount and accepted evidence from the live Students checklist and Consular Services Portal; do not assume a family support letter from outside Germany is an accepted substitute. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: GOV.UK — Student visa financial requirement and maintenance amounts
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify outstanding course fees, study location, maintenance amount and application-date threshold. HC 584 changes London/outside-London rates from 30 November 2026; cross-check Appendix Student and commencement/transitional rules at lodgement.

sources.name: Home Office — HC 584 Statement of Changes (3 September 2026)
sources.note: Official amendment source. APP ST8–ST10 take effect 30 November 2026 and change maintenance rates to £1,570/month London and £1,203/month outside London; applications made before that date are decided under rules in force on 29 November 2026 for these changes.

sources.name: Home Office — Student and Child Student caseworker guidance (work conditions)
sources.note: Official caseworker guidance for sponsor/course-specific work conditions. Manually verify 20-hour, 10-hour or no-employment categories, term/vacation periods and prohibited work against Appendix Student ST 26 and the student's eVisa conditions.

sources.name: UKVI — Financial evidence for Student and Child Student applicants
sources.note: Official evidence guidance. Verify 28-day holding, 31-day evidence timing, account access and regulation, parent funds/consent, student loan or official sponsorship evidence and nationality differential arrangements.

sources.name: IRCC — Graduate student study permit application and doctoral processing
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. IRCC currently advertises 2-week processing for eligible doctoral students and accompanying family members. Treat as a processing initiative, not a guaranteed service standard or approval. Manually verify current programme eligibility, completeness and live instructions. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: Department of Home Affairs — Student visa family-member inclusion and subsequent entrants (2026 rules)
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Manually verify exemptions, same-time/same-location requirements, transitional cases and the restriction on adding subsequent entrants after grant. Changes effective 2 October 2026. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: Department of Home Affairs — What applicants and education agents must do under 2026 Student visa application changes
sources.note: Availability-only automated check. Verify onshore/offshore lodgement eligibility, offshore grant-location rule, invalid application risks and transition for applications lodged before 2 October 2026. Detection is not legal interpretation.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Student fund requirements
sources.note: Official student maintenance funds, outward travel, tuition payment, sponsorship/financial undertaking and source-of-funds evidence. Tertiary/English/non-compulsory study: NZD 20,000 per year or NZD 1,667 per month for shorter study; verify live rates and applicant-specific sponsor rules.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Post-Study Work Visa
sources.note: Official PSWV requirements, duration, application deadline, NZD 5,000 living funds, online-only application from 16 November 2026, and new Graduate Diploma eligibility. Check exact qualification, time studied in New Zealand, visa history and current instructions.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Qualifications needed for a Post-Study Work Visa
sources.note: Official eligible qualification categories and non-degree Level 4–7 qualification list. Verify exact NZQCF level, full-time study duration and whether employment must be related to the qualification.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — New and updated post-study work visa options (16 November 2026)
sources.note: Official announcement: new 6-month Short-Term Graduate Work Visa from 16 November 2026 for eligible Level 5–7 graduates; PSWV extension to Level 7 Graduate Diploma holders who also hold a bachelor's degree; online-only PSWV applications from 16 November. Treat as future-dated until commencement; check exact conditions and transition.

sources.name: Immigration New Zealand — Short-Term Graduate Work Visa
sources.note: Official new visa page; applications open 16 November 2026. Verify NZQCF Level 5–7 qualification, full-time 24-week in-country study, exclusion of English/foundation/bridging/micro-credentials and PSWV-eligible qualifications, 3-month application window, NZD 5,000 funds, no previous PSWV/short-term graduate visa, health/character and employer-only work conditions.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — How to apply for a long-term study visa
sources.note: Official long-stay D study visa route for study over 90 days, application up to 3 months before travel, applicant location, acceptance letter, passport validity, insurance and supporting evidence.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — Information on student finances
sources.note: Official student financial evidence. €10,000 immediate access for academic courses over 8 months, €833/month or €6,665 (whichever lower) for shorter courses; subsequent-year funding, six-month bank histories, sponsor evidence, source-of-funds and approved degree-student education bond.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — ILEP and TrustEd Ireland eligibility
sources.note: Official current provider/course eligibility transition: non-EEA/non-Swiss recruitment only to ILEP-listed or eligible TrustEd-authorised programmes; ILEP closed to new providers, final update 20 June 2025; confirm exact course and provider status.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — Planning to study in Ireland
sources.note: Official course eligibility, full-time study, ILEP/TrustEd, Stamp 2 work conditions and warning that students must support themselves without relying on casual work.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — Immigration permission stamps
sources.note: Official Stamp 2/2A/1G conditions, 20-hour term-time and 40-hour specified vacation work limits, registration within 90 days, and no self-employment/business under Stamp 2/1G.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — Third Level Graduate Programme
sources.note: Official Stamp 1G route for eligible NFQ Level 8 (up to 12 months) and Level 9+ (up to 24 months subject to renewal); current Stamp 2, six-month application deadline, award evidence, time limits and employment conditions.

sources.name: Immigration Service Delivery — Student FAQs
sources.note: Official student guidance on attendance, language-course limits, work hours, family restrictions, fees, insurance, learner protection and student pathway.

sources.name: Quality and Qualifications Ireland — TrustEd Ireland
sources.note: Official QQI information on TrustEd Ireland statutory quality mark and provider authorisation for international education.

sources.name: France-Visas — Student visa, resources, work and study stay
sources.note: Official student visa route, admission, long-stay visa, 964 annual work-hour limit, indicative fees and study stay information. Manually verify current applicant-specific checklist.

sources.name: France-Visas — Student visa financial threshold notice
sources.note: Official notice states applications submitted from 1 August 2026 require proof of resources of at least EUR 877.50 per month. Confirm current threshold and application date at lodgement.

sources.name: Service-Public — Foreign student visa and residence permit
sources.note: Official public-service guidance on VLS-TS validation within three months, EUR 100 validation tax, monthly resources and examples of sponsor evidence.

sources.name: Campus France — VLS-TS student visa
sources.note: Official Campus France explanation of the student VLS-TS, 964 hours annual work cap, EEF procedure applicability and online validation within three months.
